title: Tôi không hiểu
summary: Different ways to say "I don’t understand" in Vietnam, with the phrase to start with, reusable pieces, and related next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi không hiểu answers the traveler question "I don’t understand" in moments when Vietnamese stops making sense. This is for when someone is speaking too quickly or using unfamiliar words. Lead with this before you ask for a repeat or a simpler version. Its job is keeping the useful noun or action in the center of the phrase. Expect a short answer, gesture, or practical next step; then use Explore next if the reply creates another small task.
